subject: Dinner on 06/14 in Nashville for AI Leaders?
text:
Hi Chad,

If you're in Nashville for CVPR, I’d love to personally invite you to a
small dinner we’re hosting for a group of AI leaders on 06/14.

We’ll kick off with a fireside chat with Luc Vincent—ex-VP of AI at Meta,
Chief R&D Officer at Nexar— followed by dinner for AI leaders in Nashville
this Saturday - we'd love for you to join if you’re interested / can make
it!

We've booked a private dining room at Moto Nashville, capping attendance at
~25 people and it's strictly reserved for senior leaders (CTOs, Heads of
ML, Co-founders) from our existing Encord partners and/or other leading
AI/ML scale-ups and orgs - confirmed are Safely You and Verkada from the
video surveillance space.

A bit of context on Encord - we help over 200 AI teams improve data quality
for model development. We focus on consolidating data curation, annotation
and model evaluation with the goals of efficiency gains for training
dataset preparation & model iterations.

Let me know if you’re interested/free - happy to send over the full details.

Cheers,
James

subject: Encord Follow up + Next steps
text:
Hi team,

Great chatting with you again yesterday - exciting to learn over the last 2
weeks about the mission at Frontera.  Appreciate you also sharing details
of the curation and annotation challenges you're facing on the path to
scaling your AI development.

Starting a thread to summarize discussions to date + next steps:

   - Frontera is developing a digital phenotyping AI for therapists
   treating patients with autism and related disorders
      - extensive data curation and annotation is needed in order to
      support development
      - challenges with existing solutions prevent the team from scaling
      efficiently, specifically,
         - manual video curation efforts by engineering/ops that take too
         much time/efforts to find relevant moments
         - performance/usability issues in Label Studio (can't load long
         form video, poor UX, audio and video not directly sync'd)
         - no way to prioritize/manage annotation tasks at scale or
         accommodate custom IOA criteria for label QA
      - Where Encord fits in:
      - *Data curation* platform that allows for large scale filtering,
      incl the ability to ingest file/frame level metadata from video
      transcripts, to quickly find relevant video moments for annotation (incl
      false negative mining)
         - saves time by addressing challenges related to current manual
         curation run by engineering/ops
      - *Workflow management, prioritization, and QA support *that enables
      large scale annotation management and prioritization, as well as
ability to
      meet custom IOA criteria needs for QA; accommodates ability to pre-label
      w/custom models
         - improves overall project management through seamless
         integrations of curation + annotation workflows, as well as
         distribution and prioritization of annotation/QA work, removes need to
         manually import/export data between keypoints in data development
      - *Multimodal data annotation* platform that provides flexibility to
      accommodate existing annotation tasks and future video annotation tasks
      (BBs/segmentations/etc)
         - improved UX for annotators
